description: Check whether an address sits inside our Washington coverage and resolves precisely enough to book. Use when the customer wants an area answer without searching slots — search_availability already validates the area itself. Accepts: `address` (e.g. a Seattle street or ZIP) and optional `service` — notary or apostille rules differ. Returns withinServiceArea, distanceMiles, precise; if the address cannot be resolved the message says not found.

address.description: Street address, city, or ZIP to check (Washington State service area).

service.description: "notary" (default) or "apostille" — the service-area rules differ slightly.

name: check_service_area

distanceMiles.description: Straight-line miles from the Bothell office (display only, not a routed leg).

label.description: Formatted address, or null when the address could not be resolved.

message.description: Why the place is not bookable as given, or null.

precise.description: False when a street and city are still needed to pin the spot.
